charge_port.notes: Estimated: Macan Electric CCS1 through MY2026 (Porsche US); the MY2027 release announces native NACS only for the Taycan, nothing found for the Macan.

supercharger_access.notes: US: Porsche NACS DC adapter (free for existing Macan Electric owners, included with MY2026). MY2027 assumed to match MY2026 (CCS1 + adapter).

wheels.notes: Estimated: 2026 Macan Electric Turbo AWD page shows 20-inch; the 2027 Macan Electric RWD page (https://www.cars.com/research/porsche-macan-2027/specs/489385/) shows 20-inch, so 2027 is assumed unchanged. Carried from another model year or trim, not read for this exact trim and year.
Press kit: off-road design package adds 21-inch wheels; not trim-specific (launch Macan).
Press kit: up to 22-inch wheels, staggered fitment, optional; not trim-specific (launch Macan).
